title: Static and Machine
author: C. M. Winterbourne
blurb: Casper Eriksen, an insurance investigator of impossible accidents, has spent fifteen years hauling cargo through contested orbits. But when a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
